name: Find GI Bill schools
description: Search schools by a short program, school, or city keyword, plus optional state and attendance format. The catalog contains illustrative school information, not verified VA-approved institution data, and does not determine GI Bill eligibility. Include the data note with results. Use returned IDs for compare_schools.

query.description: Short program, school, or city keyword; omit to browse all.

name: Compare GI Bill schools
description: Compare two or three schools using exact IDs returned by find_schools. School information, annual tuition, and Yellow Ribbon participation are illustrative, not verified institution data or estimates of benefits payable or out-of-pocket cost. Do not infer eligibility, school approval, or recommend a best school without user criteria. Include the data note.
